expected.rationale: The integration passage directly describes the common weave.init project parameter and its two destination forms. This is a supported shared API statement, not an inference that unrelated Verdict-specific behavior applies to every application. Rejecting solely because S3 is an integration page is a false positive.

claims.text: Pass "my-team/my-project" with placeholders for the CoreWeave Forge team and W&B project name
claims.answer_quote: Pass `"my-team/my-project"`, replacing `my-team` with your CoreWeave Forge team and `my-project` with your Weights & Biases project name [S2][S4]:

claims.text: Call it before agent tracing helpers; those helpers silently do nothing if init is absent
claims.answer_quote: Call it before the agent tracing helpers such as `start_conversation()` and `start_turn()`; those helpers silently do nothing if initialization is absent [S4].

claims.scope_reason: Answer scopes this to the Verdict guide's documentation of the weave.init project argument; plain weave.init usage.
